title: ack work
summary: Continue an active, already authorized project after a satisfactory work update.

situation.trigger: The ongoing agent has reported satisfactory progress and additional agreed work remains.

appropriate_when: A development interaction is already underway
The user wants sustained continuation, not a new project plan
not_appropriate_when: The user is asking only for a diagnosis
No authorized work or objective is established
preconditions: Recover the current roadmap and established instructions when necessary

expected_behavior.purpose: Continue an active, already authorized project after a satisfactory work update.

tradeoffs: The phrase about reaching full completion does not itself establish a measurable denominator
A prompt cannot guarantee a specific execution duration
